payload.title: Security & abuse hardening: rate limits, retention/pruning, replay bound, CORS patterns, artifact signing
payload.description:
Production security/abuse follow-ups flagged across the threat model:

- No per-principal connection cap or per-principal throughput limit; only global caps + auth-attempt limiter exist (threat-model.md:309, 314-315).
- Idempotency cache + stream-store rows grow unbounded — no retention/pruning (threat-model.md:164-165, 310-311).
- Replay window unbounded — requestId honored indefinitely (threat-model.md:168-170).
- CORS is exact-string match only; no subdomain/pattern matching for many per-tenant origins (threat-model.md:251-252).
- Schema artifacts are unsigned — a compromised build pipeline could ship a poisoned schema bundle; signing is deferred (threat-model.md:213-216).
- Service principals (machine identities w/ scopes + audit) and broader abuse-event correlation (hardening spec §"Security operations").

Target: per-principal rate limiting, durable retention/pruning, bounded replay, pattern CORS, signed schema artifacts, service-principal model.
